name: Gorton's Simply Bake Haddock Filets (Bake-in-Bag Mild White Fish)
whyItWorks: 100% wild haddock fillets seasoned lightly and sealed in parchment bake-bags. The fish steams gently in its own juices in the oven, with ZERO fried breading, under 2g fat, and zero fiber. Extremely light and flaky on sensitive intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake in bag at 375°F for 24 minutes. Cut bag open and serve tender fish over white rice or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Zero fried batter; an exceptional, effortless lean seafood meal.
